QuestInfo.name: [Theme Dungeon] Golden Temple
QuestInfo.0:
When a popular tourist spot, the Golden Temple, became overrun with violent monkeys, Somchai the caretaker went to investigate. He's been missing ever since, and his young apprentice, Noi, is desperate for help.

- #eRecommended Level#n: Lv. 130 - Lv. 135
- #eRoute#n
   1) Accept the quest, 'Noi the Monk's Plea' 
   2) Use the Crane (Taxi) in Mu Lung Garden

- #eFinal Reward#n  
                #i1003068:# #t1003068#
                #i1142385:# #t1142385#
